name: @aimino/syntaro-mcp
description: MCP server for STAS — Solving Tickets As A Service. Submit GitHub issues, list runs, search codebase, and get automated fix PRs via OpenCode agents.

syntaro_label_issue.name: syntaro_label_issue
syntaro_label_issue.description: Label a GitHub issue with the STAS fix label (or custom label).

syntaro_run_fix.name: syntaro_run_fix
syntaro_run_fix.description: Trigger the STAS fix pipeline for a GitHub issue URL.

syntaro_check_status.name: syntaro_check_status
syntaro_check_status.description: Check the current status of a STAS fix run by run_id.

syntaro_get_pr.name: syntaro_get_pr
syntaro_get_pr.description: Get the pull request URL and details for a completed STAS fix run.

list_issues.name: list_issues
list_issues.description: List tracked issues with their STAS fix status, with optional filters.

search_codebase.name: search_codebase
search_codebase.description: Search the STAS codebase for symbols, files, or patterns.

syntaro://runs/{run_id}.name: Fix Run Status
syntaro://runs/{run_id}.description: Real-time status and PR link for a STAS fix run.

syntaro://issues/{issue_id}.name: Issue Fix Status
syntaro://issues/{issue_id}.description: Issue details including current fix status, run history, and linked PRs.

STAS_MCP_SERVER_URL.description: URL of the STAS MCP server

STAS_MCP_PORT.description: Port for the MCP SSE server

MCP_API_KEY.description: API key for authenticating MCP requests

stdio.description: Stdio transport for tools like OpenCode and Claude Desktop

sse.description: Server-Sent Events transport for real-time MCP communication
